cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_questionnaire_keyboard_worker C)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT TARGET test_questionnaire_keyboard)
add_executable(test_questionnaire_keyboard "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_keyboard.c")
target_link_libraries(test_questionnaire_keyboard PRIVATE cui_software cui)
cui_warnings(test_questionnaire_keyboard)
add_test(NAME questionnaire_keyboard COMMAND test_questionnaire_keyboard)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET questionnaire_keyboard_guide)
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/QUESTIONNAIRE_KEYBOARD.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" example "${guide}")
if(NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing Questionnaire keyboard C example")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/questionnaire_keyboard_guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(questionnaire_keyboard_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/questionnaire_keyboard_guide.c")
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_keyboard_guide PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(questionnaire_keyboard_guide)
endif()
include(CheckLanguage)
check_language(CXX)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER AND NOT TARGET questionnaire_keyboard_header)
 enable_language(CXX)
 add_library(questionnaire_keyboard_header OBJECT "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_keyboard_header.cpp")
 target_link_libraries(questionnaire_keyboard_header PRIVATE cui)
 target_compile_features(questionnaire_keyboard_header PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
 cui_warnings(questionnaire_keyboard_header)
endif()
